observed_data: joint fitted mB/x1/c covariance where using summaries

stages.name: pipeline_detection
stages.limit: Conditional on expected simulator SNR/cadence; measured flux/error is not the historical DES trigger input.

stages.name: host_spectroscopic_redshift
stages.limit: Empirical denominator is targeted-eligible host population; host detection/targeting/association still required; grid does not include cell count uncertainty.

stages.name: loose_simulator_cuts
stages.limit: Not the final fitted-SALT quality sample.

stages.name: fitted_quality
stages.implementation: must run identical light-curve fitter and cuts on simulated flux
stages.input: fit convergence, rest-frame coverage, 2 bands SNR>5, |x1|<3, |c|<0.3, sigma_x1<1, sigma_tpeak<2, fitprob>0.001
stages.limit: True x1,c thresholding cannot replace noisy fitted selection.

stages.name: analysis_membership
stages.implementation: must explicitly reproduce or redefine selection before comparison
stages.input: detected host, host-derived z, Chauvenet, valid bias correction, systematic-variant CID intersection
stages.limit: Raw hierarchy may need a different declared sample; do not inherit model-dependent membership invisibly.

stages.name: classification_contamination
stages.limit: Nominal cosmology retains low-P(Ia) events; PBEAMS is already distance-dependent. Treating same-flux class posterior as independent likelihood double counts data.

normalization: For fixed conditions u: p(y|selected,u,theta)=integral S(y,v,u)*p(y|v,u,theta)*p(v|u,theta)dv / Z(theta,u). Evaluate all selection stages consistently. Include type-specific selection in the mixture and rate normalization if event counts are used.
selected_importance_identity: E_{p0(v,y|selected,u)}[p_theta(v,y|u)/p0(v,y|u)]=Z(theta,u)/Z(0,u), only under absolute continuity, fixed identical selection and exact joint proposal. Z0 cancels only where fixed and common to comparisons.
prohibition: Do not use selected mocks as an unbiased generated denominator. Do not identify SIM_SALT2c or SIM_SALT2mB with fitted effective SALT values. Do not apply proposal reweighting to unsupported luminosity/cosmology shifts.
support_evidence: All 71946 released selected Ia rows satisfy SIM_mB-SIM_mu+alpha*SIM_x1-beta*SIM_c=-19.365 within 2.9e-6 mag, and SIM_MAGSMEAR_COH=0. At fixed full latent conditions luminosity support is effectively singular.
forward_solution: Generate parent injections with SIMGEN_DUMPALL and retained failures; vary luminosity using supported GENMAG_OFF_GLOBAL/ZVARIATION inputs, rerun measured-flux fitting/cuts; audit generated counts and coverage before using fitted selection emulator.

empirical: Released DES SIMLIB contains 10000 sky-position libraries with observed MJD, exposureID, filter, gain, sky, PSF and zero-point. Documentation states creation from DiffImg sky noise/PSF/ZPT.
imposed: Sampling a library location/date and treating its recorded conditions as representative of candidate population.
Coadded/effective PSF and noise compression rather than re-running detector pixels.
falsifiers: Compare real and simulated per-band cadence, season gaps, PSF, SKY_SIG and ZEROPT by field/season/redshift before fitting cosmology.
Crossmatch real IMGNUM/exposure IDs to SIMLIB entries; identify uncovered or duplicated observing-condition regions.

empirical: DES-SN5YR_DES_FLUXERRMODEL_SIM.DAT reports421634FAKE and390257SIM observations, field/band/SBMAG correction maps and per-bin counts.
Flux uncertainty correction informed by image-overlay fakes and real off-transient tests; Kessler2019 section6.4 and Sanchez2024 section2.6.
imposed: Analytic source/sky/host noise with empirical scale; not fresh pixel-level injection.
Released correction map sets REDCOV0.6 on the added-fudge noise component, not total flux, in each band and field group; independent search and correlated template components are separate.
Grid extrapolation/empty bins; shallow-g brightestbin reports0fake observations.
Host profiles and SN positions approximate local surface brightness.
falsifiers: Test real held-out standardized flux residual mean, robust scale, tails and inter-epoch correlations by field,band,SBMAG,PSF,sky,phase,observedSNR.
Use independent non-transient/pre-explosion flux when available, acknowledging SMP fixes reference-epoch transient flux to zero so fitted references cannot independently validate that constraint.
Compare reported flux errors at matched observing conditions without any distance-redshift model.
Separate model residuals from noise using phase/band/host-dependent coherent residual patterns and DIFFIMG-versus-SMP differences.

empirical: Single-epoch efficiency versus expected SNR measured from image-overlay fakes, including operational image detection and artifact rejection.
imposed: One-dimensional SNR compression omits other dependence unless calibration demonstrated sufficient.
Two separated detection periods and simulator minimum-cuts are encoded logic.
Transporting fake-calibrated efficiency to changed colours/profiles/redshifts requires coverage.
falsifiers: Where complete detections and injected failures exist, test efficiency residuals against hostSB,PSF,band,season at fixed expectedSNR.
Compare actual observation/mask and trigger counts by field and season; selected-only real transients cannot identify missing events.

empirical: Released r_obs_auto×obs_gr_auto efficiency by field/discoveryseason, estimated for galaxies satisfying host targeting criteria.
imposed: Population host targeting distribution and simulator host assignment; smooth/clamped table interpolation.
Host rate weights (mass/SFR) and assumed matching policy.
Cell count uncertainty unavailable in released host-z grid.
falsifiers: Test held-out targeting and spectroscopic success if target lists and failures are released; hostz-conditioned cosmology sample alone is insufficient.
Use full released transient sample and secure host crossmatches to test association failures versus separation/brightness/redshift.

empirical: SALT empirical SED trained from measured light curves/spectra.
P21 and related population parameters fitted to selected DES c/x1 and standardized-residual trends through simulation; not a direct unbiased parent census.
imposed: Intrinsic-colour Gaussian, exponential reddening, mass/redshift split dust grids, intrinsic-beta distribution, stretch population and independence/conditional-factorization choices.
Spectral-time shape extrapolation; dust law and fixed model-coordinate relation; physicalRV differs from effective fitted colour coefficient.
falsifiers: Compare measured joint c/x1/host and within-z magnitude-colour-host residuals on held-out data with free z-bin intercepts.
Inspect wavelength/phase residuals on observed flux; merely improving distance residual scatter is insufficient.
Inject alternative dust, intrinsic-colour mixture and luminosity drift through flux+selection, then test coverage using a deliberately misspecified inference family.

empirical: Measured redshifts/cadence anchor placement of observed events.
imposed: Nominal generated flatLCDM Omega_m0.315,H070,w=-1 and volumetric rate POWERLAW2.27e-5*(1+z)^1.7.
Lensing and peculiar velocities use specified distributions.
Luminosity-redshift relation controls flux and detectability even when simulation cosmology is called only fiducial.
falsifiers: Inject altered luminosity-distance or absolute-luminosity redshift functions and rerun detection/fitting; test estimator bias/coverage for flexible-q alternatives.
Condition on observed z only if rate likelihood is excluded explicitly; still recompute selection normalization when flux changes.
Do not assume fiducial-cosmology independence from nominal closure or selected proposal reweighting with singular luminosity support.

empirical: Classifier trained with simulated/reweighted populations; observed spectroscopic checks constrain only their own selection regime.
imposed: Ia/CC rate/template/population and calibration mapping; SNN output is conditioned on same flux.
Fit convergence/rest-frame cuts, bias-map support, outlier decisions and systematic sample intersections.
falsifiers: Assess held-out calibrated class probabilities in matched spectroscopic samples and injected CC alternatives.
Run identical flux fitter and noisy quality cuts, retaining missing/failed cases; never replace them with true-parameter cuts.

closure_independent_test_design.split: Deterministic CID split and field/season holdouts; hyperparameters/noise scales trained on training subset only. Refit validation splits independently where nuisance leakage matters.
closure_independent_test_design.coverage: An estimator recovering its own generative family is a code closure check. Physical robustness requires different truth families and prior/noise/selection misspecification. Report coverage per truth family and MC uncertainty, not pooled pass/fail.
stress_grid: P21/BS21/G10 physical flux variants with same fitter; exact W22 remains blocked pending SN_age host input.
Noise scale and same-band interepoch correlation perturbations validated against real residual bounds.
Intrinsic-colour skew/mixture and dust mass/z changes with fit-aware selection.
Hostz/trigger perturbations limited by independent calibration uncertainty; identify unsupported cells.
cosmology_free_statistics: Heldout fittedmB residual versuscolour/stretch/host after training one unconstrained intercept perredshiftbin.
Heldout raw flux uncertainty/residual and phase/band correlation diagnostics at matched observing conditions.
avoidance: Do not count SMP reference flux fixed tozero as independent proof of zero transient baseline.
Do not count data-tuned population corrections as an independent confirmation on the same c/x1 distribution.
Do not infer absolute completeness from selected data alone.

pixel_level_availability.measured_products: Original DES5YR release provides reduced calibrated SMP epoch fluxes/errors and ancillary metadata, with DIFFIMG light curves separately released; these are not untouched detector counts.
pixel_level_availability.public_lower_level: NOIRLab documents DES DR2 single-epoch image SIA service des_dr2_se plus NOIRLab raw/calibrated image services. Existence of services does not prove every original DES-SN search/reference frame and exact calibration/PSF/mask/overlay artifact is retrievable.
pixel_level_availability.not_done: No exhaustive IMGNUM-to-archive crossmatch or new SMP pixel fit/image injection in this task. Published fake calibration is reused and stress-tested at flux level. Exact pixel-stage end-to-end reproduction remains separate and unclaimed.
